gloss: to shout, to cry out, to scream

definitions.explanation: To make a loud, high-pitched cry.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大声|おおごえ}で{叫|さけ}んだ。

notes:
{叫|さけ}ぶ means to shout, yell, or cry out loudly.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大声|おおごえ}で{叫|さけ}ぶ: to shout loudly
- {助|たす}けてと{叫|さけ}ぶ: to cry for help
- {叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}: a shout, scream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {怒鳴|どな}る: to yell (angrily, at someone)
- わめく: to scream, cry out wildly
- {悲鳴|ひめい}を{上|あ}げる: to let out a scream

RELATED:
- {叫|さけ}び: a shout, cry (noun form)
